name: Baghrir
steps: Blend semolina, flour, warm water, yeast, baking powder, sugar and salt into a smooth pourable batter.
Cover and leave in a warm place for 30–45 minutes until slightly bubbly, then stir gently.
Heat a nonstick pan on medium heat. Pour one eighth of the batter into a 14 cm round. Cook only on one side for 2–3 minutes until many tiny holes form and the surface dries.
Slide off without flipping. Repeat, spacing pancakes so they do not stick while cooling.
Melt butter and mix with jaggery syrup; spoon over the warm baghrir and serve.
tips: Baghrir is traditionally honeyed; this vegetarian version uses jaggery syrup instead.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
